Můj vlak (My Train) — Reverse-Engineered API (2.16.1 (build 332))

Download OpenAPI specification:

OpenAPI specification of the HTTP APIs used by the Android app Můj vlak / My Train (cz.cd.mujvlak.an, České dráhy, version 2.16.1), recovered by decompiling the APK with apktool 3.0.3 and jadx 1.5.6.

The app talks to four distinct back-ends:

# Back-end Purpose Base URL (production)
A MapPhone Server (MapPhoneServerWS, ODP/ČD) User accounts, IN-Karta/ČD-kredit, ticket purchase & sync, parking, payment initiation https://mapphone.cd.cz/MapPhoneServerWS.svc/
B IPWS (CHAPS/Circlegate "InterProduct WebService") Timetable search (CRWS), e-shop buy process, user sessions, tickets, refunds, ČD Bike, SMS tickets https://ipws.cdis.cz
C CGWS (Circlegate Android Service) Offline timetable catalogue download, version checks https://cd-ws.circlegate.com/AndroidService.svc
D Circlegate support WS Problem/user-support report upload https://wsandroid.circlegate.com/ServiceContractV7.svc

General notes

  • All four services exchange JSON (Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8).
  • MapPhone uses PascalCase JSON field names (Gson @SerializedName).
  • IPWS/CGWS use Hungarian-notation field names (s… string, i… int, o… object, ao… object array, as… string array, b… bool, dt… ISO date-time).
  • All clients are plain OkHttp; the IPWS/CGWS clients are built with a trust-all SSL context (certificate pinning is not used).
  • Schemas marked (partial) could not be fully reconstructed from the decompiled code.

Error codes (observed live, 2026-09)

IPWS business errors arrive as HTTP 500 + {"ExceptionType": "", "Message": "<code> <text>"} (the app treats HTTP 500 as a valid response — IpwsCommon$IpwsParam.isResponseCodeAcceptable).

Code Message (cs) Meaning
10000 Neautorizovaný přístup. Client gate — request rejected before login logic; observed when the sAppID GUID is not the currently-published app's GUID (old releases are blocked). Not a credentials problem.
10121 Zadali jste nesprávný e-mail nebo heslo. Wrong e-mail or password (normal business error from Login1).

Unknown/unimplemented commands return a plain HTTP 404; GET on a command endpoint returns 405 (only POST is accepted).

IPWS – Session & Login

IPWS session lifecycle and user login/registration.

Create IPWS session (auto-called when sSessionID missing; also logs the user in)

Request Body schema: application/json
required
iLang
integer [ 0 .. 4 ]
Default: 0
sAppID
required
string

App GUID — the SERVER GATES ON THIS VALUE and only accepts the GUID of the currently published (v32) app: {A6AB5B3E-8A7E-4E84-9DC8-801561CE886F}. The older GUID compiled into app releases up to ~2.16.x, {1532A12E-0D17-4B83-A9BB-8827EAD33F26}, is rejected by a server-side client filter with error 10000 Neautorizovaný přístup. before any login logic runs (verified live 2026-09). The GUID per server type is selected in IpwsUtils.getAppId().

sUserDesc
string

Device fingerprint built by IpwsUtils.getUserDesc(), see schema IpwsUserDesc for the exact format.

sUser
string or null
sPwd
string or null
sToken
string or null

Firebase token

iTokenType
integer

1 = Firebase

object (IpwsRegisterNotificationsSettings)

Login with e-mail + password; reports accepted agreement versions. This is the app's standard login: call CreateSession anonymously first (sUser="", sPwd=""), then authenticate with Login1 on the returned sSessionID (LoginActivity.executeTask "TASK_LOGIN").

Request Body schema: application/json
required
iLang
integer [ 0 .. 4 ]
Default: 0
sSessionID
required
string

Session id obtained from CreateSession

sUser
string

e-mail

sPwd
string
sUserDesc
string (IpwsUserDesc)

Device fingerprint, pipe-separated, built by IpwsUtils.getUserDesc(): appVersionCode|sdkVersion|deviceModel|androidId^serial|installId|lang|country|densityDpi|widthPixels|heightPixels|versionName. On SDK >= 29 androidId/serial are omitted but the '^' separator is always appended; installId is a random UUID generated on first app start (CommonDb.resetInstallId()). Example: 352|34|SM-S918B|^|8f14e45f-1234-5678-9abc-def012345678|cs|CZ|440|1080|2400|2.19.0

object (IpwsAgreementVersions)
